title: dha needs a tick that PERFORMS its gate run on a deployed Factory, with a mid-run Workflow restart
body: ncv built every component and no tick owned the run, so the gate was never performed and the review was the first to notice. dha should carry an explicit gate-run tick, blocked on nu9, t5p, cxk, 53s, us2 and e9n. It runs a real small epic through EpicReconcilerWorkflow on a deployed Factory with max_parallel > 1, restarts the Workflow while an attempt is in flight, and reports the intervention count mechanically.
